  subnet-calculator → SubnetCalculatorTool, uuid-generator → UuidGeneratorTool, whois → WhoisTool.
(Confirm each component's exact export name + props by reading `components/marketing/tools/` and the matching `app/(marketing)/tools/<slug>/page.tsx`. Some tool components may take props like initial data resolved server-side in the marketing page — replicate that server-side data fetching in the portal page the same way. Read a few marketing tool pages first to learn the pattern, e.g. my-ip, whois, ssl-checker, dns-lookup, port-checker.)

1. Read `app/(marketing)/tools/page.tsx` (the index — for the tool list, titles, descriptions, categories, icons) and several `app/(marketing)/tools/<slug>/page.tsx` files to learn: which component each renders, what server-side props/data each needs, and metadata.
2. Read `components/ui/primitives.tsx` for `PageHeader` (portal header) and available portal primitives (`.card`, `EmptyState`, `Badge`, `.btn-primary`, `.section-label`). Portal pages live under `app/dashboard/` and are automatically wrapped by the dashboard Shell/layout — do NOT add your own nav/shell.
3. Create `app/dashboard/tools/page.tsx` — an in-portal index: `PageHeader title="Free tools" sub="..."`, then a responsive card grid of all 16 tools (title + one-line description + category, reuse the same copy/grouping as the marketing index), each linking to `/dashboard/tools/<slug>`.
4. Create `app/dashboard/tools/<slug>/page.tsx` for EACH of the 16 tools. Each: `export const dynamic` as the marketing page has it if needed; a `PageHeader` with the tool's title + a short sub; a small "← All tools" link back to `/dashboard/tools`; then render the SAME reusable tool component (import from `@/components/marketing/tools/...`) with the SAME server-side data the marketing page passes it. Do NOT reimplement tool logic — reuse the component. Keep it a server component where the marketing page is one (fetch data server-side), passing serializable props to the client tool component.
5. Match the portal look: use `PageHeader` + `.card`, consistent spacing. Keep it clean and consistent with other portal pages (e.g. `app/dashboard/servers/page.tsx`).

HARD CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT modify the marketing `app/(marketing)/tools/**` pages or `components/marketing/tools/**` components or `ToolShell` — only READ them and REUSE the tool components. (If a tool component is not exported in a reusable way, still import it as-is; do not edit it.)
- Do NOT edit `app/dashboard/layout.tsx` (the nav is already updated), `components/portal/Shell.tsx`, `components/portal/PortalHero.tsx` (may not exist yet — ignore), or any file outside `app/dashboard/tools/`.
- Do NOT run `git`, `npm`/build, or prisma. Create files only.
- If a specific tool needs a server action or API that only exists for the marketing route, reuse that same action/route (import it) — do not duplicate backend logic.

REPORT BACK (concise): list the files created (index + 16 tool pages), note any tool whose component needed special server-side props and how you handled it, and flag any tool you could NOT bring in-portal and why. If any component export name differed from the guess above, note the correction.
